
## 1) Setup

```{r libs_paths}
required_pkgs <- c("dplyr", "tibble", "jsonlite", "HiCImpute", "Matrix", "ggplot2")
missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing R packages: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
}

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(jsonlite)
library(HiCImpute)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)

source(file.path("R", "helpers_ramani_io.R"))
source(file.path("previous_R_code_example", "Functions.R"))

score_bin <- Sys.which("score")
if (!nzchar(score_bin)) {
  fallback_candidates <- c(
    "/home/xchen/miniconda3/envs/score/bin/score",
    "C:/Users/67402/.conda/envs/score_py39/Scripts/score.exe"
  )
  existing <- fallback_candidates[file.exists(fallback_candidates)]
  if (length(existing) > 0) score_bin <- existing[[1]]
}
if (!nzchar(score_bin)) stop("`score` command not found.")

raw_data_dir <- file.path("external", "SCORE", "examples", "data", "oocyte_zygote_mm10", "1M")
anchor_file <- file.path("external", "SCORE", "examples", "data", "mm10.genome_split_1M")
ref_file <- file.path("external", "SCORE", "examples", "data", "oocyte_zygote_ref")

if (!dir.exists(raw_data_dir)) stop("Missing raw pair dir: ", raw_data_dir)
if (!file.exists(anchor_file)) stop("Missing anchor file: ", anchor_file)
if (!file.exists(ref_file)) stop("Missing reference file: ", ref_file)

cfg <- list(
  min_depth = 5000,
  mc.cores = 1,
  cutoff = 0.5,
  niter = 1000,
  burnin = 500,
  chr_subset = character(0)
)

cat("score path:", score_bin, "\n")
```

## 2) Match Reference Cells to Raw Pair Files

```{r match_cells}
ref <- read.delim(ref_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!all(c("cell", "depth", "cluster") %in% names(ref))) {
  stop("Reference file must include columns: cell, depth, cluster")
}

pair_files <- list.files(raw_data_dir, full.names = FALSE)
pair_files <- pair_files[!grepl("\\.tmp$", pair_files)]

normalize_key <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("\\.1m$", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x
}

pair_tbl <- tibble(
  cell_file = pair_files,
  key = normalize_key(pair_files)
)

ref2 <- ref %>%
  filter(!is.na(cell), !is.na(cluster), !is.na(depth), depth >= cfg$min_depth) %>%
  mutate(key = normalize_key(cell)) %>%
  left_join(pair_tbl, by = "key") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cell_file)) %>%
  distinct(cell_file, .keep_all = TRUE)

if (nrow(ref2) < 2) stop("Too few matched cells after filtering.")

ref_subset <- ref2 %>%
  transmute(
    cell = cell,
    depth = depth,
    batch = if ("batch" %in% names(ref2)) batch else 1,
    cluster = cluster
  )

out_root <- file.path("data", "schicimpute_score_compare_from_pairs")
dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ref_subset_file <- file.path(out_root, "oocyte_zygote_ref_min_depth_5000.tsv")
write.table(ref_subset, ref_subset_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)

cat("Matched cells:", nrow(ref2), "\n")
```

## 3) Reuse Existing RAW .scool

```{r cooler_raw}
run_score_cmd <- function(args, label) {
  cat("\n[", label, "]\n", sep = "")
  cat("score ", paste(args, collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
  stdout_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".log")
  stderr_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".log")
  status <- system2(score_bin, args = args, stdout = stdout_file, stderr = stderr_file)
  out <- if (file.exists(stdout_file)) readLines(stdout_file, warn = FALSE) else character(0)
  err <- if (file.exists(stderr_file)) readLines(stderr_file, warn = FALSE) else character(0)
  cat("Return code:", status, "\n")
  if (length(out) > 0) cat(paste(out, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
  if (!identical(status, 0L)) {
    cat("\n--- STDERR ---\n")
    if (length(err) > 0) cat(paste(err, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
    stop(label, " failed.")
  }
}

raw_scool <- file.path("data", "bhzip_score_compare_from_pairs", "oocyte_zygote_raw_1M.scool")
if (!file.exists(raw_scool)) {
  stop("Missing existing raw scool: ", raw_scool, "\nBuild or copy it first before running this Rmd.")
}
cat("Reusing existing raw scool:", raw_scool, "\n")
```

## 4) scHiCImpute from Raw Pair Files (All Chromosomes)

```{r schicimpute_from_pairs}
imp_dir <- file.path(out_root, "schicimpute_1M")
dir.create(imp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

anchors <- read.delim(anchor_file, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(anchors) <- c("chr", "start", "end", "idx0")
all_chr <- unique(anchors$chr)
if (length(cfg$chr_subset) > 0) all_chr <- intersect(all_chr, cfg$chr_subset)
if (length(all_chr) == 0) stop("No chromosomes selected for imputation.")
run_start <- Sys.time()
total_chr <- length(all_chr)
chr_elapsed <- numeric(0)

for (cid in ref2$cell_file) {
  fout <- file.path(imp_dir, cid)
  if (file.exists(fout)) file.remove(fout)
  file.create(fout)
}

read_pair_file <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.info(path)$size == 0) {
    return(data.frame(bin1 = integer(0), bin2 = integer(0), count = numeric(0)))
  }
  x <- tryCatch(read.table(path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), error = function(e) data.frame())
  if (nrow(x) == 0 || ncol(x) < 3) {
    return(data.frame(bin1 = integer(0), bin2 = integer(0), count = numeric(0)))
  }
  x <- x[, 1:3]
  colnames(x) <- c("bin1", "bin2", "count")
  x$bin1 <- as.integer(x$bin1)
  x$bin2 <- as.integer(x$bin2)
  x$count <- as.numeric(x$count)
  x <- x[!is.na(x$bin1) & !is.na(x$bin2) & !is.na(x$count), , drop = FALSE]
  x
}

build_chr_long_offdiag <- function(dt, chr_ids) {
  n_bins <- length(chr_ids)
  if (n_bins < 2) return(numeric(0))

  old2new <- integer(max(chr_ids) + 1L)
  old2new[chr_ids + 1L] <- seq_len(n_bins)

  in_chr <- dt$bin1 %in% chr_ids & dt$bin2 %in% chr_ids
  if (!any(in_chr)) return(rep(0, n_bins * (n_bins - 1L) / 2L))

  d <- dt[in_chr, , drop = FALSE]
  d <- d[d$bin1 != d$bin2, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(rep(0, n_bins * (n_bins - 1L) / 2L))

  i <- old2new[d$bin1 + 1L]
  j <- old2new[d$bin2 + 1L]
  ii <- pmin(i, j)
  jj <- pmax(i, j)

  sp <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = ii,
    j = jj,
    x = d$count,
    dims = c(n_bins, n_bins)
  )
  sp <- sp + Matrix::t(sp)
  mat <- as.matrix(sp)
  # Match the old HiCImpute simulation workflow:
  # scHiC should be upper-triangle, off-diagonal only.
  mat[upper.tri(mat, diag = FALSE)]
}

write_imputed_offdiag_chr <- function(v, out_file, global_ids) {
  # At this point v has already been converted back to the standard
  # lower-triangle off-diagonal long format, so reconstruct it as lower.
  mat <- matrix_long_to_matrix2D_offdiag(as.numeric(v), triangle = "lower")
  mat[!is.finite(mat)] <- 0
  mat <- round(mat)
  keep <- upper.tri(mat, diag = FALSE) & mat > 0
  if (!any(keep)) return(invisible(NULL))

  ij <- which(keep, arr.ind = TRUE)
  out <- data.frame(
    bin1 = global_ids[ij[, 1]],
    bin2 = global_ids[ij[, 2]],
    count = as.integer(mat[keep]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write.table(out, file = out_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, append = TRUE)
}

for (chr_idx in seq_along(all_chr)) {
  chr_name <- all_chr[chr_idx]
  chr_start <- Sys.time()
  cat(sprintf("\n[%d/%d] Processing %s for scHiCImpute...\n", chr_idx, total_chr, chr_name))
  chr_ids <- anchors$idx0[anchors$chr == chr_name]
  n_bins <- length(chr_ids)
  if (n_bins < 2) next
  n_pairs <- n_bins * (n_bins - 1L) / 2L
  cat("n_bins=", n_bins, " | n_pairs=", n_pairs, "\n", sep = "")

  Y_chr <- matrix(0, nrow = n_bins * (n_bins - 1L) / 2L, ncol = nrow(ref2))
  colnames(Y_chr) <- ref2$cell_file

  for (k in seq_len(nrow(ref2))) {
    f <- file.path(raw_data_dir, ref2$cell_file[k])
    dt <- read_pair_file(f)
    if (nrow(dt) == 0) next
    Y_chr[, k] <- build_chr_long_offdiag(dt, chr_ids)
  }

  scHiC <- Y_chr
  bulk_vec <- rowSums(scHiC)

  fit <- HiCImpute::MCMCImpute(
    scHiC = scHiC,
    bulk = bulk_vec,
    expected = NULL,
    n = n_bins,
    mc.cores = cfg$mc.cores,
    cutoff = cfg$cutoff,
    niter = cfg$niter,
    burnin = cfg$burnin
  )

  Y_imp_chr <- apply(fit$Impute_SZ, 2, function(x) {
    mat2d <- matrix_long_to_matrix2D_offdiag(x, triangle = "upper")
    matrix2D_to_matrix_long(mat2d, include.diag = FALSE)
  })
  if (is.null(dim(Y_imp_chr))) {
    Y_imp_chr <- matrix(Y_imp_chr, ncol = 1L)
  }
  colnames(Y_imp_chr) <- colnames(Y_chr)

  for (k in seq_len(ncol(Y_imp_chr))) {
    write_imputed_offdiag_chr(
      v = Y_imp_chr[, k],
      out_file = file.path(imp_dir, colnames(Y_imp_chr)[k]),
      global_ids = chr_ids
    )
  }

  rm(Y_chr, Y_imp_chr, fit)
  gc(FALSE)

  chr_sec <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), chr_start, units = "secs"))
  chr_elapsed <- c(chr_elapsed, chr_sec)
  mean_chr <- mean(chr_elapsed)
  remaining <- total_chr - chr_idx
  eta_sec <- remaining * mean_chr
  cat(
    sprintf(
      "Completed %s in %.1f min | avg/chr %.1f min | ETA %.1f min\n",
      chr_name, chr_sec / 60, mean_chr / 60, eta_sec / 60
    )
  )
}

cat("scHiCImpute files written at:", imp_dir, "\n")
```

## 5) Build scHiCImpute .scool (`score cooler`)

```{r cooler_schicimpute}
schicimpute_scool <- file.path(out_root, "oocyte_zygote_schicimpute_1M.scool")
run_score_cmd(c(
  "cooler",
  "--dset", "oocyte_zygote_schicimpute",
  "--data_dir", imp_dir,
  "--anchor_file", anchor_file,
  "--reference", ref_subset_file,
  "--resolution", "1M",
  "--out", schicimpute_scool
), "score cooler scHiCImpute")

cat("Built scHiCImpute scool:", schicimpute_scool, "\n")
cat("Total elapsed (min):", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), run_start, units = "mins")), 1), "\n")
```

## 6) Next Steps

```{r example_contact_heatmap_raw_vs_schicimpute}
# Quick sanity check heatmap for one cell / one chromosome.
# This mirrors the style used in the other comparison notebook.

target_chr <- "chr1"
requested_cell <- NULL  # set explicitly if you want a specific file name

chr_ids <- anchors$idx0[anchors$chr == target_chr]
if (length(chr_ids) < 2) stop("Chromosome not found or too few bins: ", target_chr)

build_chr_mat <- function(pair_dir, cell_file, chr_ids) {
  n_bins <- length(chr_ids)
  f <- file.path(pair_dir, cell_file)
  d <- read_pair_file(f)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins))

  keep <- d$bin1 %in% chr_ids & d$bin2 %in% chr_ids
  d <- d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins))

  old2new <- integer(max(chr_ids) + 1L)
  old2new[chr_ids + 1L] <- seq_len(n_bins)
  i <- old2new[d$bin1 + 1L]
  j <- old2new[d$bin2 + 1L]

  ok <- i > 0 & j > 0 & !is.na(i) & !is.na(j)
  i <- i[ok]
  j <- j[ok]
  w <- d$count[ok]
  if (length(i) == 0) return(matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins))

  mat <- matrix(0, nrow = n_bins, ncol = n_bins)
  for (k in seq_along(i)) {
    ii <- i[k]
    jj <- j[k]
    mat[ii, jj] <- mat[ii, jj] + w[k]
    if (ii != jj) mat[jj, ii] <- mat[jj, ii] + w[k]
  }
  mat
}

pick_example_cell <- function(dirs) {
  available <- dirs[dir.exists(dirs)]
  if (length(available) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  file_sets <- lapply(available, function(d) list.files(d, full.names = FALSE))
  common <- Reduce(intersect, file_sets)
  if (length(common) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  if (!is.null(requested_cell) && requested_cell %in% common) return(requested_cell)
  sort(common)[1]
}

cell_file <- pick_example_cell(c(raw_data_dir, imp_dir))
if (is.na(cell_file)) stop("Could not find a common cell across raw and scHiCImpute pair directories.")

input_tbl <- tibble::tribble(
  ~method,         ~pair_dir,     ~label,
  "Raw",           raw_data_dir,  "Raw",
  "scHiCImpute",   imp_dir,       "scHiCImpute"
)

mat_to_df <- function(mat, method, label) {
  n <- nrow(mat)
  expand.grid(i = seq_len(n), j = seq_len(n), KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      count = as.numeric(mat[cbind(i, j)]),
      method = method,
      label = label
    )
}

heat_df <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(input_tbl)), function(ix) {
  mat <- build_chr_mat(input_tbl$pair_dir[ix], cell_file, chr_ids)
  mat_to_df(mat, input_tbl$method[ix], input_tbl$label[ix])
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = c("Raw", "scHiCImpute")),
    value = log1p(count)
  )

pos_vals <- heat_df$value[is.finite(heat_df$value) & heat_df$value > 0]
count_max <- if (length(pos_vals) > 0) {
  as.numeric(stats::quantile(pos_vals, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE))
} else {
  suppressWarnings(max(heat_df$value, na.rm = TRUE))
}
if (!is.finite(count_max)) count_max <- 1
count_max <- max(count_max, 1e-6)

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = j, y = i, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 2, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    limits = c(0, count_max),
    option = "plasma",
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "log1p"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Example Contact Heatmap | ", target_chr, " | cell: ", cell_file),
    subtitle = "Raw vs scHiCImpute | scale=log1p(count), cap=99.5%",
    x = "bin",
    y = "bin"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p_heat)
```
